messages:
Alex: Quick poll Lunch challenge: treadmill intervals vs stair ladder ladder (12:30). Who's up for a sweaty 20m? :sweat_smile: :running:
Priya: Im in for intervals. 6 x 1min hard / 1min rest sounds perfect for lunch. Anyone want to pace?
Ben: Stair ladder sounds like a medieval torture device but I might be tempted. How many reps? :eyes:
Alex: Thinking 8 flights x climb, slow descent for recovery, repeat 4 rounds. Low-impact if you take it easy.
Noor: Can I do a hybrid? 2 rounds of stairs then 10 mins treadmill cool-down? Got a client at 1:15 so need to be quick.
Priya: Hybrid sounds good. Also heads up: there are towels by the showers and a hairdryer in locker 1 if anyone needs it.
Health-bot: Event created: "Lunchtime intervals vs stairs" @12:30 (30m). Reminder 5m before.
Ben: Safety check: stairs are a bit squeaky and the rail has paint flakes. Recommend gloves or wipe hands after.
Alex: Good shout. Ill bring a pair of cheap gloves and microfiber towel. Also coffee wager: winner (fastest over 4 rounds or most reps) gets a free coffee from losers. :coffee:
Noor: Im no sprinter, so Ill take the 'most consistent form' prize instead. Might be more attainable. :sweat_smile:
Priya: Bring a phone with timer or we can use my Tabata app. Quick warmup: 5 min easy jog + leg swings.
Ben: Count me tentatively for stairs (2 rounds) and if I dont die maybe treadmill.
Alex: Meetup: lobby at 12:25. If wet, we shift to treadmill-only. Post a 1-line summary here after so late-joiners know. Pics in #random okay.
Noor: Ill bring a silly sticker for the winner to stick on their laptop. Low-stakes glory.
Priya: See you in 25! Also reminder to rehydrate after, electrolytes in the fridge.
Alex: Final tally: Intervals 1 (Priya), Stairs 2 (Ben, Alex), Hybrid 1 (Noor). See you soon.
